1º de Bachillerato · Inglés I

Examen de prueba del 2º trimestre

Temas: Modal verbs and modal perfects · Conditionals · The passive and the causative · Reported speech.

Nombre: ______________________   Fecha: ___________   Nota: ______

  1. «She ___ speak four languages.»

  2. Futuro de can:

  3. «You ___ use your phone in the exam.» (prohibido)

  4. «You ___ come if you don't want to.»

  5. Pasado de must (obligación):

  6. Logro concreto en el pasado:

  7. «You'd better ___ now.»

  8. Petición más cortés:

  9. «He ___ be at home; his car isn't here.»

  10. «She ___ be tired; she's been working all day.»

  11. Modal perfect para crítica:

  12. «It ___ rained; the ground is wet.»

  13. «I needn't have bought bread» significa…

  14. «Should've» se escribe…

  15. Deducción sobre el pasado, posibilidad:

  16. «We ___ to leave the hotel at night.» (pasado, prohibido)

  17. «Would you mind closing the door?» — Para aceptar:

  18. «The train ___ arrive at 6; it's on time.»

  19. Hedging en un ensayo:

  20. «You could have been killed!» expresa…

  21. Rewrite: «I'm sure Paul forgot about the meeting.» → «Paul ___ about the meeting.»

  22. Rewrite: «It wasn't necessary to bring food, but we did.» → «We ___ food.»

  23. Choose the correct option: «Visitors ___ feed the animals. It's strictly forbidden.»

  24. Find the mistake: «Although the sea was rough, all the passengers could reach the shore.»

  25. Complete: «You ___ told me you were vegetarian! I've cooked chicken.»

  26. Choose the most polite request in a formal email.

  27. Complete: «That ___ be the right answer. It doesn't make sense.»

  28. Choose the correct pair: «When I was little I ___ swim, but last summer I ___ swim across the lake.»

  29. Zero conditional:

  30. «If it ___ tomorrow, we'll stay in.»

  31. «If I ___ you, I'd see a doctor.»

  32. «If I had a dog, I ___ it every day.»

  33. «If she ___ the bus, she wouldn't have been late.»

  34. «If I'd known, I'd have come»: los dos 'd son…

  35. Condicional mixto (pasado → presente):

  36. «___ you hurry, you'll be late.»

  37. «Take some water ___ you get thirsty.»

  38. «You can stay ___ you're quiet.»

  39. «I wish I ___ taller.»

  40. «I wish I ___ that.» (arrepentimiento)

  41. «I wish you ___ shouting!»

  42. «I hope / wish»: «I ___ you have a great trip.»

  43. «It's time we ___.»

  44. «I'd rather ___ at home.»

  45. Inversión correcta:

  46. «___ you need help, call reception.»

  47. «But for your help, I ___.»

  48. «We must go now; ___ we'll miss the train.»

  49. Rewrite: «I didn't have enough money, so I didn't buy the tickets.» → «If I ___.»

  50. Rewrite: «I don't speak German, so I can't apply for the job.» → «If I ___.»

  51. Choose the correct option: «If he ___ harder at school, he ___ a better job now.»

  52. Find the mistake: «Unless you don't book in advance, you won't get a table.»

  53. Rewrite formally: «If you have any questions, please contact me.»

  54. Complete: «I wish I ___ to the concert last night. Everyone says it was amazing.»

  55. Complete: «___ it not been for the firefighters, the whole building would have burnt down.»

  56. Choose the best sentence for an opinion essay.

  57. La pasiva se forma con…

  58. «English ___ all over the world.»

  59. «The bridge ___ in 1890.»

  60. «A new school ___ at the moment.»

  61. «The results ___ tomorrow.»

  62. ¿Qué verbo NO admite pasiva?

  63. Agente correcto:

  64. «The window was broken ___ a stone.»

  65. «This must ___ immediately.»

  66. «I hate ___.»

  67. Pasiva con dos objetos más natural:

  68. «The children are looked ___ by their aunt.»

  69. «He is said ___ very rich.»

  70. «She is believed ___ the country.»

  71. «I had my car ___.»

  72. «I got my sister ___ me.»

  73. «They made us ___.»

  74. Pasiva de «They let me go»:

  75. «He ___ injured in the match.» (informal)

  76. Titular de prensa:

  77. Rewrite in the passive: «They haven't repaired the lift yet.»

  78. Rewrite: «People believe that the painting was stolen in 1990.» → «The painting ___ in 1990.»

  79. Rewrite: «A technician is installing our new air conditioning.» → «We ___.»

  80. Find the mistake: «The accident was happened at midnight and two people were injured.»

  81. Complete: «Students ___ to leave the classroom without permission.»

  82. Choose the best passive for a scientific report.

  83. Rewrite: «It is said that the actress is preparing a new film.» → «The actress ___.»

  84. Complete: «The new law ___ when the government collapsed.»

  85. «She ___ me she was busy.»

  86. «He ___ that it was late.»

  87. «I'm cold» → She said she ___ cold.

  88. «I've lost my bag» → He said he ___ his bag.

  89. «I'll phone you» → She said she ___ me.

  90. «tomorrow» en indirecto (días después):

  91. «Where do you live?» → She asked me where ___.

  92. «Are you OK?» → He asked ___ I was OK.

  93. «Don't shout!» → She told us ___.

  94. «Can you help me?» → She asked me ___ her.

  95. «I'll carry it for you.» → He ___ to carry it.

  96. «I didn't do it!» → He ___ doing it.

  97. «Let's go out.» → She suggested ___ out.

  98. «Sorry I'm late.» → He apologised ___ late.

  99. «You cheated!» → They accused him ___.

  100. No hay retroceso si el verbo introductor está…

  101. Verdad general:

  102. «You should rest.» → The doctor ___ me to rest.

  103. «here» en indirecto (en otro lugar):

  104. «Who broke it?» → She asked who ___ it.

  105. Report: «I'm meeting my friends tonight», said Sara.

  106. Report: «Have you ever been to Japan?» he asked me.

  107. Report: «Don't leave your bags unattended», the announcer said to the passengers.

  108. Choose the correct reporting verb: «I won't do it, no matter what you say», he said.

  109. Find the mistake: «She suggested me to apply for the scholarship.»

  110. Report: «What will you do after Bachillerato?» my aunt asked me.

  111. Complete: «The company ___ that the data had been stolen, but said no customers were affected.»

  112. Report: «Well done on winning the debate!» the head teacher told us.

Soluciones

  1. B) Modal sin -s ni to.
  2. D) Can no tiene futuro.
  3. A) Prohibición.
  4. C) Sin obligación.
  5. C) Had to.
  6. A) Managed to / was able to.
  7. D) Had better + base.
  8. B) Would you mind + -ing.
  9. A) Deducción negativa.
  10. C) Deducción afirmativa.
  11. B) Should have = crítica.
  12. D) Deducción sobre el pasado.
  13. B) Acción innecesaria realizada.
  14. D) Nunca *should of.
  15. A) Modal + have + participio.
  16. C) Prohibición en pasado.
  17. C) Respuesta negativa = acepto.
  18. A) Expectativa lógica.
  19. D) Matiza con could.
  20. B) Could have = posibilidad no realizada.
  21. A) Deducción afirmativa sobre el pasado.
  22. D) Acción innecesaria realizada.
  23. B) Prohibición en norma formal.
  24. A) Logro concreto en una ocasión.
  25. C) Reproche.
  26. B) Would / could de cortesía.
  27. D) Deducción negativa en presente.
  28. B) Capacidad general negativa y logro concreto.
  29. B) Presente + presente.
  30. D) Presente en la condición.
  31. A) If I were you.
  32. C) Second conditional.
  33. C) Third conditional.
  34. A) 'd + participio = had; 'd have = would.
  35. D) Past perfect + would + base.
  36. B) A menos que te des prisa.
  37. A) Precaución.
  38. C) Siempre que.
  39. B) Deseo irreal presente.
  40. D) Past perfect.
  41. B) Queja: would.
  42. D) Deseo posible: hope.
  43. A) It's time + past simple.
  44. C) Mismo sujeto: base.
  45. C) Had + sujeto + participio.
  46. A) Inversión con should.
  47. D) But for = si no hubiera sido por.
  48. B) De lo contrario.
  49. A) Third conditional.
  50. D) Second conditional.
  51. B) Mixto: pasado → presente.
  52. A) Unless ya es negativo.
  53. C) Inversión con should.
  54. B) Arrepentimiento pasado.
  55. D) Inversión negativa.
  56. B) Second conditional bien formado.
  57. B) Be en el tiempo adecuado.
  58. D) Present simple pasivo.
  59. A) Past simple pasivo, participio built.
  60. C) Present continuous pasivo.
  61. C) Futuro pasivo.
  62. A) Intransitivo.
  63. D) By + agente.
  64. B) Instrumento: with.
  65. A) Modal + be + participio.
  66. C) Gerundio pasivo.
  67. B) Persona como sujeto.
  68. D) Se mantiene la preposición.
  69. B) Sujeto + is said + to + infinitivo.
  70. D) Hecho anterior: to have + participio.
  71. A) Have + objeto + participio.
  72. C) Get + persona + to.
  73. C) Make + base en activa.
  74. A) Let → be allowed to.
  75. D) Pasiva con get.
  76. B) Se omite be.
  77. A) Present perfect pasivo.
  78. D) Infinitivo perfecto pasivo.
  79. B) Causativa en present continuous.
  80. A) Happen es intransitivo.
  81. C) Let no tiene pasiva.
  82. B) Past simple pasivo.
  83. D) Infinitivo continuo para acción en curso.
  84. B) Past continuous pasivo.
  85. B) Tell + objeto.
  86. D) Say sin objeto.

  88. C) Present perfect → past perfect.
  89. C) Will → would.
  90. A) Tomorrow → the next day.
  91. D) Orden afirmativo.

  94. C) Ask + objeto + to.

  97. B) Suggest + -ing.
  98. D) Apologise for + -ing.
